searchText: To use glv you have to use point from prime order subgroup. This is the requirement which makes the endomorphism a multiplication map which is exactly what we need to make this acceleration. Haven’t analyzed the proof yet but it I think we can be quite sure about it BTW. For G2 point multiplication blst uses GLS which is faster than GLV. Did not have time to read the paper yet but from its very beginning it looks similar and uses the same assumption of the subgroup order.
